name: AR-223
notes: Sightmark Core TX kılavuzu: 'The Sightmark Core TX 4x32AR-223 and 1-4x24 AR-223 are equipped with the AR-223 Reticle.'; 'The AR-223 reticle is a second focal plane reticle.'; '.223 Rem. 55gr. FMJ', '100 yard zero'; 'The design provides a 1.34 MOA central aiming dot at 4x magnification' -> center_dot=true, unit=moa (ayar ½ MOA); 'circle dot' (1x'te 50 yd'de ~20 inç); holdover 300/400/500/600 yd, 'for a 300 yard holdover, the tip of the vertical subtension is used'; 'Ballistic holdovers, however, must be performed at the highest magnification.' Holdover açısal değerleri yalnız şekilde -> family ve sayısal alanlar null. Ürün sayfası (4x32): 'Reticle: AR-223', 'BDC reticle calibrated for .223 55 grain', '2nd'.
